newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRANCE BEAT SWEDEN 1-0 IN FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRANCE BEAT SWEDEN 1-0 IN FRIENDLY.

text.p: France beat Sweden 1-0 (half-time 1-0) in a friendly international on Wednesday

France - 16-Fabien Barthez; 15-Lilian Thuram (3-Patrick Blondeau 69), 5-Laurent Blanc, 8-Marcel Desailly, 2-Vincent Candela; -Claude Makelele, 4-Patrick Vieira (4-Martin Djetou 68), 13-Ibrahim Ba (17-Marc Keller 83), 10-Zinedine Zidane (14-Franck Gava 57), 6-Youri Djorkaeff, 19-Christophe Dugarry (11-Patrice Loko 57).

Sweden - 1-Thomas Ravelli; 2-Roland Nilsson (14-Gary Sundgren 57), 4-Joachim Bjorklund, 5-Teddy Lucic, 3-Patrick Andersson; 6-Nicklas Alexandersson, 8-Jesper Blomqvist (17-Henrik Larsson 69), 10-Martin Dahlin (16-Jurgen Petterson 59); 7-Par Zetterberg (15-Stefan Schwarz 47) , 9-Andreas Andersson, 11-Kennet Andersson.
